b.speaker: voice
b.text: Congratulations on the ratings, Miss Moreno. Harcourt was a supporting role. You were magnificent.

c.speaker: voice
c.text: That Polaroid. 'A.V.' Tommy's stunt coordinator was Arlo Vance. He keeps dogs now. Out past Yermo, at the salvage yard.

d.speaker: voice
d.text: He likes to say his dogs eat better than the crew ever did. Go and see what he feeds them.

f.speaker: cass
f.text: Arlo taught Tommy how to fall off a building. The trick, he said, is to never think about the ground.

q1.speaker: cass
q1.text: Dogs have good ears. So do the people who keep them.

z.speaker: narration
z.text: The star is still on the bathroom mirror. She doesn't wipe it off.
